vibe_rationale: Curated designer and small-business market with live music and a launchpad record for Gold Coast brands, but commercial, locally rooted and now on hiatus.
fit_notes: Burleigh locals and visitors shopping local design, vintage and lifestyle goods, a wellness-adjacent crowd at most. A stall or sampling spot would be cheap, but no events are scheduled and the pause may be permanent, so it is an archive candidate unless it returns.
